title.narrative: Aman for the Care of Syrian Orphans

description.narrative: Monthly sponsorship of $50 for 600 orphans. - Distribution of (school bags with stationery - three personal hygiene bags and two seasonal clothes) for 600 orphans. - Providing psychosocial support and social interactive activities for 600 orphans. - Training of 150 female heads of households on (sewing - cheese and dairy production - homemade food production - raising and caring for cows). - Providing professional tools (for sewing - dairy production - homemade food production) Distribution of livestock (cows) to the beneficiaries.

Supporting orphans and female family members affected by the earthquake in northern Syria by providing monthly sponsorship, basic necessities, and psychological and social support. In addition, we are empowering female family members by providing vocational training and necessary tools in sewing, cheese and dairy production, home-made food production, and raising and caring for cows.

The project seeks to alleviate the suffering of Syrian orphans affected by the earthquake in northern Syria and improve their living and humanitarian conditions by providing monthly sponsorship, school bags and personal hygiene kits, and seasonal clothing. Psychosocial support and interactive activities are also provided for orphans to alleviate their suffering caused by wars and earthquakes. In addition, the project aims to improve the living and economic conditions of 150 families (female heads of orphans) through economic empowerment activities by providing specialized vocational courses and distributing vocational tools and livestock to beneficiaries.
